translation.name: YISU KILISI ANE BINGE VIE GIENGK IWAL AVOS

content: Bing-ai gipil avie vwivwei bage isgabu
Be Yisu ginei, “Sawa ebe Pomate ve nemb amolmol dabin ok, weik ebe avie vwivwei bage isgabu ivwat as lam be iro amol ebe ve nemb avie ok, avkavut nangge luev ile ok.
Eisir bage tavlu dabas-gwet ma be bage tavlu eisir tis dabas-gwet vie be itpweng gen are.
Sotol bage tavlu ebe itpweng gen are ite ok, ivwat as lam bemem ivwat karasin subu givin ite.
Be sotol ebe itpweng gen are ok, ete ivwat as lam be tis karasin subu gisov gen mate givin is-ate.
Amol ebe ve nemb avie ok ginme seukie ite, be avie gaptol bage isgabu nok matanos bunam molge be iengk.
Be givin tambok luvwe amol ti gital ginei, “Amol ebe ve nemb avie ok ete ginme nik be unamdil be unro ei avkavut unde.”
Beti eisir imdil be itung as lam gitang-tangi ge.
Be sotol bage tavlu ebe itpweng gen are ite ok inei gitangi as nune-nggen be inei, ‘Unemb karasin subu ve amei kob ve ande amei karasin ma.
Be eisir ebe itpweng gen are ok inei, ‘Karasin eteik gitangi eitit tepwengge ite. Be unde be unavgo karasin ve aim.’

Beti sotol ebe itpweng gen are ite ok ile ve inavgo karasin ve is. Be givin ebe sotol ile ok, be amol ebe ve nemb avie ok gibielk. Be sotol bage tavlu ebe ipasang is-ate yapin ok, ile isov nam aplo ivin amol ebe ve nemb avie ok, be es nam avo avwut.
Be givin ebe avie gaptol tavlu ebe ile ve inavgo as karasin ok, imbielk be ital ve amol ebe ve nemb avie ok be inei, ‘Amol bamo os nam avo ponge ve amei.’
Bemem amol ebe ve nemb avie ok ginei, ‘Ayeu tangg gisgil yem.’ Be Yisu ginei;
“Dang-etok be yemunpasang aim-ate yapin, ve yem unini sawa ebe atob ayeu nanumul nanme ok.”
Bing-ai gipil amol bamo ti ane amol kulkul ane aitol
“Asonge nindeb mulane atob weik ebe amol bamo ti ve nivang taku undib ge ti, be ei gital ane amolmol kulkul ane inme be geb ane gen walang ok gisov eisir bais ve inemb dabin ok.
Ei geb K5,000 gitangi amol ti, be K2,000 gitangi amol ti, be K1,000 gitangi amol ti. Ei geb gen etok gitangi ane amolmol kulkul ane ve inalgum kulkul nipil bekob givang.
Amol ebe gigas K5,000 ok gile be geb kulkul gipl mone etok be gigas K5,000 vukuri meng-givin.
Be amol ebe gigas K2,000 ok gile be gilum weik etok ge be gigas K2,000 meng-givin.
Bemem amol ebe gigas K1,000 ok gile be gitav nalk avo be givwaivun ane amol bamo etok ane mone giengk nalk aplo.
Bwayage kob amol bamo nok ginumul ginme ve nili ane mone ebe geb gitangi ane amolmol kulkul ane ok ane ano.

Beti amol ebe gigas K5,000 ok gitangi ane amol bamo gile be givwat mone ebe geb kulkul be gigas ok givin ei ate be gile. Ei ginei gitangi ane amol bamo be ginei, ‘Mie gob K5,000 ge gitangi ayeu be ayeu gale be gab kulkul gipil be gagas K5,000 eteik ginme givin.’

Be amol bamo ginei gitangi ei, ‘Mie amol vie molge be amol kulkul ane vie ti be gob gen siti-ngge etok dabin vie molge. Beti atob ayeu namb mie ve nomb gen walang ok dabin. Unme be umbweg tis tam vevie-ngge nuvin ayeu.’
Be amol ebe gigas K2,000 ok ginme be ginei gitangi ane amol bamo, ‘Mie gob K2,000 ge gitangi ayeu, be ayeu gab kulkul gipil be gagas K2,000 eteik ginme givin.’

Be ei ane amol bamo ginei gitangi ei, ‘Mie amol kulkul ane vie molge be gob gen siti-ngge etok dabin vie molge. Usov unme be umbweg tis tam vevie-ngge uvin ayeu. Be atob ayeu namb gen walang ok nitangi mie ve nomb dabin.’

Be bwayage kob amol ebe gigas K1,000 ok gitangi ane amol bamo gile be gine, ‘Amol bamo. Ayeu gatpweng mie are ganei mie amol gwang-ne be amol tis arem ti, be gen ebe amolmol subu ivro ok, bemem mie gugas ane ano.
Dang-etok beti ayeu gapelk be gale gaspun miam mone etok gisov nalk, be am gen nok etebeik.’
Be ei ane amol bamo ginei gitangi ei, ‘Mie amol tiate be amol wayam ane roro. Ginei mie gutpweng ayeu are gunei ayeu amol ebe gagas gen ebe amolmol subu emb ane kulkul ok ane ano,
okob etok vie ve mie nomb mone etenok nitangi amolmol ebe emb mone giwel ate ok veik atob mie nunggas mone subu nile nivin mone ete ayeu gab gitangi mie ok, be nomb nitangi ayeu.
Dang-etok be unemb mone etok ikwai ei be unemb itangi amol ebe gigas K10,000 ok,
ve amol ti ginei geb ane gen dabin vie-ngge atob ei ninggas subu nile nivin. Be amol ti ginei geb ane gen dabin vie ite, atob in-gas ei ane gen siti ebe giengk givin ei-ate ok nikwai weik etok ge.
Be unkari amol wayam ane etok isov aiweng tumi aplo ile, be nangge etok atob ei yayai be niteng anongge.’
Asonge Yisu nilgum amolmol tepwengge as yaun nindeb mulane

“Asonge Pomate Natu Ayeu ebe meng-gahlang weik amolmol, nanumul nanme weik amol bamo ebe ve nemb amolmol dabin ok be angg bogbogo tis angg ngalau kulkul ane tepwengge atob nivin ayeu. Be atob ayeu nambweg taku ebe ve naute amolmol as yaun ok.
Be amolmol nalk ane tepwengge atob inro is-ate sut inme be invarkei nindeb ayeu nangg ane. Be atob ayeu namb amolmol vusa nile dubi ailu-ngge.
Amolmol ebe aplos givin Pomate ok ete atob inambweg nindeb ayeu baingg mol ane, be amolmol tiate ane atob inambweg nindeb ayeu baingg kase ane.

Be atob ayeu nanei nitangi amolmol ebe Tamangg gili eisir ginei amolmol vie ane ok be nanei; ‘Unsov unme be unabweg taku vie ebe warik Tamangg gipasang nalk tis gulumb vaku-ngge be gipasang ve yem yapin ok.
Ve ayeu marav ges au be bui ges au, be yem omb ben tis bui luvus ve ayeu gan be ganum, ayeu amol taku ti ane bemem yem unggas ayeu gapil aim nam gale.
Ayeu kup ma be yem omb kup ve ayeu gano, gimat gilgum ayeu be yem omb ayeu dabin vie-ngge, ayeu gabweg nangge kapual-lu be ule ve utlek nangg-aim ve ayeu.”
Be atob amolmol ebe aplos givin ayeu ok atob inwel ayeu avongg be inei, ‘Amol Bamo, asger amei ali mie marav ges im be avkwen mie, mie bui ges im be amb bui luvus ve mie gunum?
Be asger amei ali mie weik amol taku ti ane be anggas mie gupil amei nam me mie kup ma be amei amb kambam ve mie guro?
Be asger mie gumat me gubweg nangge kapual-lu be amei alek atlek nangg-amei ve mie?’
Be atob ayeu nawel eisir avos be nanei. ‘Gen bambamo ebe yem ulgum gitangi awangg amol sin-ge ti ok, ete weik ebe ulgum gitangi ayeu givin ok.’

Bekob narau-lili be nanei nitangi eisir ebe ivkir dumas gitangi Pomate ok, ‘Unde ebeok unkwai ayeu. Yem amolmol tiate ane. Unkwai ayeu be untangi yev bamo ebe giengk dang-etok ok unde. Ve Pomate gipasang yev bamo etok ve Sadam tis ane amolmol-gen tiate ane yapin.
Ayeu marav ges au bemem yem uvkwen ayeu ite, bui ges ayeu be yem omb bui ve ayeu ganum ite.
Ayeu amol taku ti ane be yem unggas ayeu gapil yem aim nam ite. Ayeu kup ma bemem yem omb kambam ve ayeu garo ite. Ayeu gamat be gabweg nangge kapual-lu bemem yem omb ayeu dabin ite.’

Kob atob amolmol tiate ane nok inei nitangi ayeu dang-eteik, ‘Amol Bamo, asger amei ali mie marav ges im, be bui ges im, be kup ma, me gimat gilgum mie, me gubweg nangge kapual-lu be amei amb mie ru ite?’
Be atob ayeu nawel eisir avos be nanei, ‘Givin ebe yem uvkir dumangg-aim gitangi awangg amol sin-ge ti ok, ete yem uvkir dumangg-aim gitangi ayeu givin weik etok ge.

Dang-etok be gen ret ret ete yem ulgum ulgum ok ete atob ni-itin aim unde unsov yev bamo ebe giengk dang-etok ok aplo unde. Be amolmol ebe aplos givin ayeu be ilgum awangg yaun ano gile ok ge, ete atob inambweg matawas dang etok invin ayeu nangge Pomate ane taku vie.”
